verdict.rationale: Ledgy supports non-interactive, machine-to-machine access: service accounts created in Company Settings exchange credentials via the OAuth 2.0 client_credentials grant, and API operations like auth, companyCaptable and companyTransactions return paged and incremental data, so scripted or CI jobs can pull data headlessly. The documented API surface appears read-oriented, and the evidence shows no CLI, no CI integration guidance and no published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404). Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI tooling, documented write/automation operations via the API, a machine-readable API spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
